title: Zelenskyy accuses allies of ‘wasting time’ as he prepares for Trump meeting
summary: Ukrainian president will urge his US counterpart to impose more sanctions on Russia when they meet next week Europe live – latest news Volodymyr Zelenskyy will urge Donald Trump to impose sanctions on Russia when they meet next week at the United Nations in New York, and has called on Ukraine’s allies to “stop wasting time”. Zelenskyy said he expected further sanctions to be imposed if Vladimir Putin refuses to meet him for face-to-face talks or to agree to a ceasefire. “If the war continues and there are no moves towards peace we expect sanctions,” he said.
